tools.name: next_surah
tools.description: Advance to the next surah in the current reciter's playlist (or the next item in the queue).

tools.name: play_random_recitation
tools.description: Pick a random surah and reciter and start playing. Useful when the user has no specific preference.

tools.name: play_surah
tools.description: Play a Holy Qur'an surah by a specific reciter on this page. Looks up the reciter by slug, picks the requested surah number (1–114), and starts playback in the site's audio player.

reciterSlug.description: URL slug of the reciter (e.g. 'abdul-basit-abdul-samad'). Use search_reciters first if you only have a name.

tools.name: resume_playback
tools.description: Resume playback of the currently-loaded recitation.

tools.name: search_reciters
tools.description: Search reciters by name (Arabic or English). Returns matching reciters with their slug, names, and country.

query.description: Search term — reciter name or partial name.
